content.short: INIT Capital is a Liquidity Hook Money Market on Mantle enabling composable lending, borrowing, and yield strategies for users and protocols.
content.description: INIT Capital is a composable money market protocol that pioneered the concept of Liquidity Hooks  plugins that allow DeFi protocols to permissionlessly tap into INIT's liquidity layer to execute complex yield strategies. Launched natively on Mantle Network with backing from the Mantle EcoFund, INIT supports multi-silo positions, flash borrowing, LP token collateral, and an Auto E-Mode for maximum capital efficiency. Protocols like Merchant Moe have built margin trading hooks directly on INIT's liquidity infrastructure. Users access all integrated hooks through a single dashboard, enabling leveraged staking, looping, and other advanced strategies in just a few clicks.
